name.value: Cape Mudge RV Park & Wharf House Cottage

description.value: Cape Mudge RV Park is a secluded oceanfront campground on Quadra Island, owned and operated by the We Wai Kai Nation. It offers 30 improved RV campsites available year-round, plus a single beachfront cottage called the Wharfhouse. The associated Tsa Kwa Luten Lodge transitioned to a Wellness Centre in late 2024, but the RV park continues to operate independently as part of the We Wai Kai Band Hospitality Family.

address.value: #1 Lighthouse Road, Quathiaski Cove, British Columbia V0P 1N0, Canada
